alert.title: Travelling this summer?
alert.copy: Book travel vaccinations at least six weeks before you fly. Appointments are available now — book through the NHS App or call the surgery.

primaryTasks.title: Book or cancel an appointment
primaryTasks.copy: Routine and urgent appointments, by phone or online.

primaryTasks.title: Order a repeat prescription
primaryTasks.copy: Order in the NHS App or at reception — we can't take orders by phone.

moreTasks.title: Get help for your symptoms
moreTasks.copy: Tell us what's wrong online and we'll direct you to the right care.

moreTasks.title: Join the surgery
moreTasks.copy: Register as a new patient — done online in about ten minutes.

moreTasks.title: Get test results
moreTasks.copy: Results appear in the NHS App as soon as they are ready.

moreTasks.title: Get a fit note (sick note)
moreTasks.copy: Ask for a fit note for work without booking an appointment.

wellbeing.title: Live Well
wellbeing.copy: Sleep, exercise, food and quitting smoking
